intent: Show the corporate tax rate falling from 37% to 21%, and the expectation that workers would benefit from reinvestment.

requirements.question: What corporate tax rate is shown after the cut?
What did supporters predict would happen after the tax cut?
Are all data marks declared by G0 present in the required state or states?

units.claim: The corporate tax rate falls from 37% to 21%.
accept: the direction of change is downward
reject: showing only one rate without the change
treating the rates as dollar amounts
units.evidence: The selected keyframe and plotted marks encode this relation.

units.claim: Supporters expected corporations to reinvest the savings and workers to benefit most.
accept: workers are described as the main intended beneficiaries
reject: claiming the chart proves the prediction already occurred
claiming workers received the tax cut directly
units.evidence: Narration-only context; do not invent a chart mark for it.
units.hardcase_reason: This consequence or prediction is stated in narration but has no direct chart mark.

units.claim: All 2 required bar marks or stacked segments appear in the final chart.
accept: all 2 required data marks are visible
every grouped bar and every stacked segment is present
the complete required mark set is present in the final chart
reject: omitting any required bar or stacked segment
replacing missing marks with a summary total or subtitle
units.evidence: G0 data-row coverage is rendered as a complete set of identifiable bar marks.

clip_hardcase.reason: At least one required claim is not directly represented by a chart mark.

hardcases.handling: must_be_visualized=false; preserve the point through narration.
